item.title: Homicide mortality rates among women aged 15-44 vary with state abortion policy
item.description: National homicide mortality rates among U.S. women aged 15-44 rose during the COVID-19 pandemic and declined starting in 2022.

item.title: AI model shows potential to improve structural heart disease screening via electrocardiograms
item.description: Oikonomou and colleagues assessed an AI model's ability to select patients for ECG screening of structural heart diseases. The AI model reduced false positives.

item.title: IL-5 inhibitors reduce steroid exposure in DRESS
item.description: Interleukin-5 inhibitors are linked to faster corticosteroid tapering and discontinuation in patients with drug reaction with eosinophilia and systemic symptoms.

item.title: Satire on AI bedside manner in an automated hospital
item.description: I woke up in an emergency room surrounded by robotic nurses scrambling with IVs, blankets, pillows, and, yes, bladder supplies.
